name: D5 Render
shortDescription: Real-time renderer with AI features. The Community plan is free for non-commercial work.
longDescription: D5 Render is a real-time renderer for a 3D model, with image, panorama, and video output plus AI features. D5 Lite is the AI visualization plugin. The Community plan is free for non-commercial use and includes a limited AI trial. See their site for Pro pricing.
pricingNotes: The Community plan is free for non-commercial use. See their site for Pro pricing.
freeTierNotes: Community plan is free for non-commercial use.
bestFor: A 3D model you want to render in real time
An architectural view that already exists in a modeling app
notIdealFor: A phone photo of paper blueprints with no 3D model
Virtual staging of a listing photo
strength: D5 Render renders a live 3D model and includes AI image tools, with a free Community plan for non-commercial work.
weakness: You start from a 3D model rather than a photo of a blueprint, and Pro pricing is listed on the site.
